description: This file contains assembler macros and vector/interrupt handler definitions for the Xtensa architecture within the Zephyr RTOS, including register spilling, FPU saving, stack management, and exception handling.

methods.name: SPILL_ALL_WINDOWS
methods.description: Macro to spill all windowed registers based on the number of A registers configured.

methods.name: FPU_REG_SAVE
methods.description: Macro to save floating point unit registers to the current stack.

methods.name: FPU_REG_RESTORE
methods.description: Macro to restore floating point unit registers from the current stack.

methods.name: ODD_REG_SAVE
methods.description: Macro to save special shift/loop context registers.

methods.name: CALC_PTEVADDR_BASE
methods.description: Macro to calculate the base virtual address of the first page table entry (PTE) page for MMU.

methods.name: PRELOAD_PTEVADDR
methods.description: Macro to preload page table entries for a memory region to avoid TLB misses.

methods.name: CROSS_STACK_CALL
methods.description: Macro to set up stack for cross-stack function calls and invoke an interrupt handler.

methods.name: DEF_EXCINT
methods.description: Macro to define an exception or interrupt vector for a specific level, saving context and jumping to handler.
